command:
exec /bin/bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
umask 022
for name in $(compgen -e); do case "$name" in GH_*|GITHUB_*|*TOKEN*|*_PAT|*SECRET*|*PASSWORD*|*CREDENTIAL*|SSH_AUTH_SOCK|*ASKPASS|GIT_SSH|GIT_SSH_COMMAND|GIT_CONFIG_*|GCM_*) unset "$name";; esac; done
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GCM_INTERACTIVE=never
export GIT_SSH_COMMAND='"'"'ssh -F /dev/null -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o IdentityFile=/dev/null -o IdentityAgent=none -o BatchMode=yes'"'"'
export GH_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/fast-checks-no-gh" GH_PROMPT_DISABLED=1 && mkdir -p "$GH_CONFIG_DIR"
job="$PWD"
cache=/home/cmux/.cache/fast-checks && mkdir -p "$cache"
if command -v flock >/dev/null; then exec 9>>"$cache/.in-use.lock"; fi
if command -v flock >/dev/null && flock -n -x 9; then
  if [ ! -e "$cache/.target-checked" ] || [ -n "$(find "$cache/.target-checked" -mmin +360 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    kib=$(du -sxk "$cache/target" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1 || true)
    max=$(( ${CMUX_FAST_CHECKS_TARGET_MAX_GIB:-60} * 1048576 ))
    if [ "${kib:-0}" -gt "$max" ]; then
      echo "fast-checks: cargo target is $((kib / 1048576)) GiB, over its $((max / 1048576)) GiB bound: removed" >&2
      rm -rf --one-file-system "$cache/target"
    fi
    touch "$cache/.target-checked"
  fi
fi
if command -v flock >/dev/null; then flock -s 9; fi
export RUSTUP_HOME=/home/cmux/.rustup PATH="/home/cmux/.cargo/bin:/opt/zig-0.17.0:/opt/node-v24.11.1/bin:$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin"
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$cache/target/19834f1bd501f32e380edd7109422ab3d7206b21" CARGO_HOME="$cache/cargo" ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR="$cache/zig" CMUX_GHOSTTY_VT_ZIG_CPU=baseline GOMODCACHE="$cache/go-mod" GOCACHE="$cache/go-build"
test "$(ls inputs | grep -c '"'"'^src\.'"'"')" = 1
git init -q src && cd src
cat ../inputs/src.* | git index-pack --stdin >/dev/null
for pack in .git/objects/pack/*.pack; do : > "${pack%.pack}.promisor"; done
echo 19834f1bd501f32e380edd7109422ab3d7206b21 > .git/shallow
git config core.repositoryformatversion 1 && git config extensions.partialClone origin && git config remote.origin.url "$job/no-promisor-remote" && git config remote.origin.promisor true
git sparse-checkout set --no-cone -- '"'"'/*'"'"' '"'"'!/*/'"'"' /ghostty /ghostty-next /ci/ /cmux-tui/ /scripts/ /workers/cmux-vm/cli/
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach 19834f1bd501f32e380edd7109422ab3d7206b21
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 19834f1bd501f32e380edd7109422ab3d7206b21
export FAST_CHECKS_OUT="$job/fast-checks-out" && mkdir -p "$FAST_CHECKS_OUT"
echo "cmux-ci test on the fleet Linux pool: source=19834f1bd501f32e380edd7109422ab3d7206b21"
set +e
python3 -c '"'"'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, signal, subprocess, sys, time
sha, directory, timeout, command = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4]
root = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
where = (root / directory).resolve()
where.relative_to(root)
actual = subprocess.check_output(['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'git'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'rev-parse'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'HEAD'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'], text=True).strip()
assert actual == sha, (actual, sha)
child = subprocess.Popen(['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'bash'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'-c'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', command], cwd=where, start_new_session=True)
timed_out = False
def stop(grace):
    try:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        pass
    try:
        child.wait(timeout=grace)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        try:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        child.wait()
def stopped(signum, frame):
    stop(2)
    sys.exit(128 + signum)
for s in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGHUP):
    signal.signal(s, stopped)

    code = child.wait(timeout=timeout)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:

    stop(30)
else:

code = code if code >= 0 else 128 - code
after = subprocess.check_output(['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'git'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'rev-parse'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'HEAD'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'], text=True).strip()
print('"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'CMUX_CI_FLEET_RECEIPT='"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' + json.dumps(dict(source_sha=actual, head_after=after, exit_code=code,
      timed_out=timed_out, command_sha256=hashlib.sha256(command.encode()).hexdigest())), flush=True)
sys.exit(code if actual == after else 2)
'"'"' 19834f1bd501f32e380edd7109422ab3d7206b21 . 5400 '"'"'python3 scripts/bench/phone-default-speed/study.py'"'"'
code=$?
set -e
mkdir -p "$job/artifacts" && tar -czf "$job/artifacts/fast-checks-out.tgz" -C "$FAST_CHECKS_OUT" .
exit "$code"
'
